objective.en: Map the hottest Chicago-area neighbourhoods so cooling centres open where heat is worst.

sources.name: NASA MODIS Aqua 8-day and daily daytime land-surface temperature (via NASA GIBS)
sources.usage: Observed: heat cells are the hottest 25% of populated cells by MODIS Aqua 8-day daytime land-surface temperature, 17-24 Jun 2024 (June 2024 Midwest heat dome; threshold 36.7 C). eventDay is the first day of 2024-06-16 to 2024-06-21 that daily Aqua LST reached the threshold (day 0 = 2024-06-16; cells hidden by cloud every day stay at day 0). Cloud blocking and sensor detectability are modelled (mostly clear skies).

sources.name: NASA SEDAC Gridded Population of the World v4, 2020 density (via NASA GIBS)
sources.usage: Cells with at least 500 people per square kilometre count as populated neighbourhoods.
